calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

generation: Separate Open3D CPU baseline, every indexed depth frame. Same native backprojection, common native CPU voxel points, identity pair initialization, current-to-previous composition and frozen voxel/gate/iteration budgets as the original native plan. Open3D relative fitness/RMSE stopping thresholds are zero; no equivalent stopping or speed ranking claim. Keep failure/reset policy and geometric support acceptance unchanged. Never use groundtruth for initialization, fitting or selection.
scope: After seeing the native result, this baseline is fixed to the pre-existing geometry/budget controls; it is a diagnostic comparison on the same sequence, not a new blind holdout or a tuned native improvement.
